nodes.label: JOBS
nodes.summary: Const dict of jobs (knight, mage, gunner, summoner, healer) with combat style, primary stat, hp/def/range/interval, sprites, perk and 4 tier names with level gates 1/5/10/15.

nodes.label: '아그라' Name (TBD)
nodes.summary: Undecided referent of 'Agra': the domain, the player's house, or the whole world.

nodes.label: Day/Night Core Loop
nodes.rationale: Village and battle share one map with a day/night switch (v0.3 decision) to connect management to defense.
nodes.summary: Day (life/prep) -> dusk -> night (rift invasion) -> dawn (rewards, wages, recovery) -> next day; invasions grow, elites every 3 days.

nodes.label: Defeat: Lord's Hall Durability 0
nodes.summary: Game is lost when the lord's hall (영주관, durability 400) reaches 0.

nodes.label: Gunner (거너)
nodes.summary: Ranged single-target, DEX primary; tiers 거너/저격수/화포장/마탄의 사수; longest range, grows per tier.

nodes.label: Healer (힐러)
nodes.summary: Heal/support, WIS primary; tiers 힐러/사제/대사제/빛의 대행자; heals two at once from tier 3.

nodes.label: Injury & Downing
nodes.summary: At 0 HP a mercenary is downed for the night and wakes at dawn with 30% HP; friend downed -> morale -15.

nodes.label: Jobs & Promotion Table
nodes.rationale: Jobs are data rows so new jobs can be added without code changes (v0.4 change from 전사/궁수/사제).
nodes.summary: Five jobs defined as one row each in scripts/job_data.gd; new jobs added by appending to the table.

nodes.label: Knight (기사)
nodes.summary: Melee/defense, STR primary; tiers 기사/근위기사/성기사/천공의 수호자; taunts from tier 2.

nodes.label: Mage (마법사)
nodes.summary: Ranged AoE, INT primary; tiers 마법사/원소술사/대마법사/시간술사; area grows per tier.

nodes.label: Night Behavior
nodes.rationale: Morale directly scales attack so that mercenary well-being matters in combat.
nodes.summary: Retreat check, healer target search, friend-protect priority, rally-point radius 90; attack = base x (0.7 + morale/200).

nodes.label: 누르그마 (Nurgma)
nodes.summary: Evil god imprisoned in a time prison by the gods; seal weakens when the absoluteness of time collapses.

nodes.label: Personality Traits
nodes.summary: Three exclusive trait groups (attitude: 근면/게으름, courage: 겁쟁이/용맹, relationship: 동료애/대식가) affecting day and night behavior.

nodes.label: 1st Prototype Scope
nodes.summary: One map with hall/inn/diner/training/farm/forest/plaza/3 rifts, 4-10 mercs, day/night waves, resources and basic commands; validation questions.

nodes.label: Resources
nodes.summary: Gold, food, wood, monster residue (마물의 잔재), stone/ore (TBD) with acquisition and uses; unpaid wages drop morale by 25.

nodes.label: 누르그마의 봉인의 잔
nodes.summary: Cursed relic the player's house used to rewind time, unknowingly the key to unsealing Nurgma.

nodes.label: Story Progression
nodes.summary: Early defense, mid investigation of rifts/omegas, late realization the house's time manipulation caused doom.

nodes.label: Summoner (소환사)
nodes.summary: Summon/swarm, INT primary; tiers 소환사/정령술사/군주소환사/심연의 계약자; summons tier+1 (max 3) each night.

nodes.label: 12개의 오메가 (Twelve Omegas)
nodes.summary: Twelve distinct bosses modeled on human legend monsters, each with an independent boss stage.

nodes.label: Day Utility AI
nodes.summary: Scores rest/eat/train/farm/chop/chat by needs and traits plus random 0-15 and picks the highest.

nodes.label: 세계의 끝 영지
nodes.summary: Frontline domain guarding the border where the player's house came to stop prophesied doom.

nodes.label: 기획서 v0.4 (Game Design Doc)
nodes.summary: Game design document v0.4 for 아그라 전기: changes, overview, loop, resources, mercenary AI, jobs/promotion, lore, prototype scope.
